# Home Service Vendor Dispute Log

| **Record ID** | HSV-2025-061 |
|---------------|--------------|
| **Service Type** | HVAC System Repair |
| **Vendor** | CoolBreeze HVAC Solutions |
| **Service Address** | Home - 742 Maple Ridge Road |
| **Service Date** | June 10, 2025 |
| **Invoice / Work Order #** | CB-HV-061025-8847 |
| **Amount Paid** | $1,247.00 |

---

## Service Description
Compressor replacement and refrigerant recharge. Technician diagnosed failed compressor unit; replaced with new OEM-equivalent unit, performed full system test and calibration.

---

## Warranty Terms
- Labor Warranty: 12 months from service date
- Parts Warranty: 24 months from service date (compressor)
- Coverage: Full replacement of defective parts and associated labor

---

## Failure Event

| **Date Detected** | June 12, 2025 (2 days post-service) |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Issue** | System blowing warm air; compressor not engaging |
| **Symptoms** | Same failure pattern as prior to original repair |

---

## Vendor Response & Dispute
- **Initial Contact**: June 12, 2025 - Reported failure to CoolBreeze dispatch
- **Vendor Position**: Claims failure due to "pre-existing electrical issue" not covered under warranty
- **Refusal Basis**: Alleges issues with home electrical supply void warranty coverage
- **Documentation Gap**: No electrical inspection performed at time of service; no pre-existing condition noted on original work order

---

## Current Status

| **Status** | WARRANTY DISPUTE - ACTIVE |
|------------|---------------------------|
| **Next Step** | Arrange independent second opinion inspection |
| **Second Opinion Inspector** | To be scheduled with certified HVAC technician (non-affiliated) |
| **Inspection Goal** | Determine if failure is defect in replacement part/installation vs. external electrical fault |

---

## Supporting Documentation Log
- [x] Original invoice (CB-HV-061025-8847)
- [x] Warranty terms document
- [x] Photos of system failure (June 12)
- [ ] Second opinion inspection report - *pending*
- [ ] Formal complaint letter (draft in progress)

---

## Action Items

| Action | Owner | Due Date | Status |
|--------|-------|----------|--------|
| Schedule independent HVAC inspection | Owner | June 16, 2025 | ☐ Pending |
| Obtain written second opinion report | Inspector | June 18, 2025 | ☐ Pending |
| Draft formal complaint to vendor | Owner | June 17, 2025 | 📝 In Progress |
| Review complaint with consumer protection (if needed) | Owner | June 20, 2025 | ☐ Pending |
| File complaint with state contractor board (if unresolved) | Owner | July 1, 2025 | ☐ Pending |

---

## Notes
- Vendor verbally acknowledged system was functional post-service on June 10
- No electrical anomalies detected during original service; system ran 48 hours successfully
- Have bank/credit card statements showing payment
- Warranty terms do not exclude electrical-related failures
- May escalate to credit card dispute if vendor continues refusal after second opinion
